cards.title: Co-moving frequency transformation
cards.role: Maps laboratory frequency to the pump frame and defines every phase-matching root.

checks.reason: Main Eq. (1) gives the exact co-moving transformation; evaluating its plotted curve still requires the unpublished fibre beta(omega).
The independent Sellmeier-plus-capillary implementation is finite across the declared material interval and continues beyond it by an explicit tangent rule.
The declared physical surrogate does not recover the printed 1551 nm horizon; this expected model gap is recorded as missing measured fibre coefficients rather than repaired from Fig. 2 pixels.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate fused-silica Sellmeier n(lambda), subtract the scalar capillary transverse mode term, derive u/c from the surrogate pump group index, and form omega-u beta. Sweep the explicit effective-core-radius assumption.
open_questions: The measured/fitted beta coefficients are not published.

cards.title: Negative resonant radiation root
cards.role: Defines the spontaneous negative-frequency resonant-radiation marker.

checks.reason: The NRR root relation is identified in Main Fig. 2(c); Main Eq. (1) itself defines only the co-moving frequency transformation.
Broad-bracket bisection on the formula-only default surrogate returns the NRR root near 232.1 nm; this is a reconstructed feature, not a paper-exact result.

cards.numerical_form: Scan and bisect on the 7-10 rad/fs UV interval without encoding source-figure coordinates.

cards.title: Stimulated Hawking-partner root
cards.role: Defines the ultraviolet partner of the infrared probe.

checks.reason: The identity is stated in Main Methods Eq. (B.1), not in the supplementary equation sequence.
The clean surrogate resolves a distinct negative-frequency partner and records its displacement from the paper's approximately 233 nm result as a missing-dispersion-parameter gap.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate omega-prime at the probe, negate it, and find the UV-branch root.

cards.title: Backreaction phase-matching root
cards.role: Defines the conjugated-SPM backreaction channel and its blue shift from the Hawking partner.

checks.reason: The identity is stated in Main Methods Eq. (B.3), not in the supplementary equation sequence.
Across the clean default surrogate the backreaction root is blue of the Hawking partner; its exact separation is not scored because the measured dispersion is unavailable.

cards.numerical_form: Form the co-moving target from pump and probe, then bisect on the UV branch.

cards.title: Analytic-signal unidirectional propagation equation
cards.role: Advances the positive-frequency analytic field through the fibre.

checks.reason: The analytic-signal UPPE is Supplement Eq. (3); Main Methods Eq. (A.1) is the real-field wave equation.
With gamma=0, both integrators equal the exact linear phase solution.
Negative laboratory-frequency bins remain exactly zero.

cards.numerical_form: FFT pseudo-spectral nonlinear RHS with exact co-moving linear phase and a positive-frequency mask.
open_questions: The public paper does not provide a complete executable beta(omega) coefficient table.

cards.title: Cubic-polarization channel decomposition

source_refs.value: three cubic terms in Supplement Eq. (3)

cards.role: Separates THG, ordinary SPM, and conjugated SPM for the causal counterfactual.

checks.reason: The three cubic channels are stated in the supplementary propagation model.
Term weights disable only conjugated SPM while preserving identical initial fields.

cards.numerical_form: Four batched scenarios share the same FFT grid; the third term weight is one or zero.

cards.title: Sech-pulse power normalization

source_refs.value: pulse FWHM, average power, and 80 MHz repetition rate

cards.role: Converts disclosed laser parameters into deterministic initial field amplitudes.

checks.reason: Pulse FWHM, average powers, and repetition rate are stated in Methods/Supplement.
Integrating P0 sech^2(t/T0) gives 2 P0 T0 = pulse energy.

cards.numerical_form: Pulse energy is average power divided by repetition rate; field amplitude is sqrt(power).
open_questions: Measured chirp, detailed pulse shape, and pump-probe delay are not reported numerically.

cards.title: Power-law sideband amplitudes
cards.role: Turns ultrashort-pulse modulation into a geometric sideband ladder.

checks.reason: The coefficient and modulation map are stated in Methods Eq. (C.3).
For zero backreaction and isolated peaks, adjacent sideband intensities decay as X squared.

cards.numerical_form: Sum integer sideband orders from -10 through 10; omitted terms are below the plotted resolution for fitted X values.

cards.title: Backreaction sideband asymmetry
cards.latex: \widetilde g_m=\begin{cases}\widetilde g_-+i\widetilde g_B/X,&m<0,\\\widetilde g_- - i\widetilde g_B X,&m\ge 0.\end{cases}
cards.role: Makes the band intensities asymmetric and exposes the backreaction contribution.

checks.reason: The piecewise amplitudes are stated in Methods Eq. (C.4).
The synthetic test makes the blue/backreaction sideband stronger only when the backreaction intensity is non-zero.

cards.numerical_form: Use |g_-|^2+|g_B|^2/X^2 for m<0 and |g_-|^2+|g_B|^2X^2 for m>=0 after incoherent averaging.

cards.title: Incoherently averaged Hawking spectrum

source_refs.value: Eq. (D.1) and the following peak-profile definition

cards.role: Generates all six black theoretical curves in Nature Fig. 4.

checks.reason: The incoherent sum, peak centres, profile, and six mu values are stated in Methods D.
At mu=1 the numerical integral agrees with sech squared to 2e-7.

A synthetic formula-generated spectrum is recovered by the independent fitting test, and the scientific campaign evaluates all six mu values as a parameter-sensitivity family without reading Fig. 4 markers.

cards.numerical_form: Tabulate the normalized profile integral and evaluate a declared width/modulation/backreaction sensitivity grid for each of the six printed mu values. No source marker is a fit input.
open_questions: The raw spectra and six fitted values of omega-minus, omega-B, Delta, X, |g-minus|^2, and |g-B|^2 are not published.

cards.title: Thermal normalization and equal-slope test
cards.role: Tests whether Hawking radiation and backreaction share the same effective thermal slope.

checks.reason: The normalization and equal-slope prediction are stated in Methods Eqs. (D.2-D.3).
Taking logarithms of Eqs. (D.2-D.3) gives equal coefficients of omega-plus/omega-one; the formula-only runner verifies exactly equal slopes in a dimensionless gauge.
A comparison-only vector audit suggests a plotted-line/exclusion-policy discrepancy, but raw points and fresh-context review are missing, so no paper-error candidate is promoted.

cards.numerical_form: Generate two affine log-probability families with one shared dimensionless slope. The plotted points, intercepts, and slope magnitude remain unavailable.
open_questions: Exact raw NRR photon fluxes, fitted amplitudes, and red-shifted frequencies are unavailable.
